description: WHAT: Europe/Berlin wall clock to the second (stand YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS CEST|CET) for pricing whenKey context. Optional slug|plz|name like get_service_area; omit = all 52 places with the same clock. RETURNS timezone, stand, iso, unix, date, time, tz, and whenKey day|night for www invoicing. USE before quoting via www get_invoice_line_items. DOES NOT return euro amounts (no price matrix on maps). NEXT: www @ikeytz/mcp get_invoice_line_items({situationKey, whenKey}) or get_prices.

name.description: German place name substring (case-insensitive, umlauts ok), e.g. Grünbühl, Pattonville. Used when slug/plz omitted.

plz.description: German postcode (PLZ). Several Gebiete can share one PLZ (e.g. 71638). For single lookup first match wins; use find_by_plz for all matches.

slug.description: URL slug of one of the 52 Einsatzgebiete, e.g. pattonville, bietigheim-bissingen, walheim, gruenbuehl. Matches https://maps.ikeytz.com/{slug}. Lookup order when combined with plz/name: slug first.
